description: Brainograph shared kernel (rewrite, v2): frozen platform wire contracts (response envelope, DataProvider models/executor, entity bases, permission/role enums), JWT authentication, the exception-to-envelope map, and the envelope-typed BaseApiClient.
releaseNotes: 6.10.0 — Paged queries now run over a TOTAL order. Both DataProvider executors appended Skip/Take to whatever ordering the caller happened to supply, which was not necessarily deterministic: GetPagedSelectListAsync applied a sort ONLY when filter.Sort was non-empty, so a caller that omitted it paged over a completely unordered query (EF flags this — it was firing ~70 times a day in production); and GetVuePagedSelectListAsync fell back to CreatedAt desc, which silences the warning but is not unique, leaving rows that share a timestamp free to reorder between pages. PostgreSQL guarantees no row order without ORDER BY and may return a different one for the same query on the next call, so in both cases a row straddling a page boundary could be returned twice or skipped entirely — silently, with no error, presenting as items duplicating or vanishing while a user scrolls. Both executors now append the projected type's Id as a final sort key, after any caller ordering, making every page deterministic; types without an Id are unchanged. No API change and no change to which rows a correctly-sorted query returns — the caller's own sort still decides the order, the tiebreak only resolves ties it left open. PREVIOUSLY, 6.3.0 — No API change; the package now ships its XML documentation file and a buildTransitive props registering it as an AdditionalFiles input to the XML→OpenAPI source generator, so the response-envelope types (SuccessResponseModel<T>, ErrorResponseModel, ResponseModel, AppStatusCodes, etc.) document themselves in a consuming service's own OpenAPI document — .NET 10 discovers a ProjectReference's XML automatically, but not a package's. Bumped rather than repacking 6.2.0 in place, for the same NuGet-caching reason 3.1.0 records: 6.2.0 was already packed and published before this props file and XML doc file were added to its csproj, so a service restoring "6.2.0" from the feed silently gets the OLD package with neither asset. PREVIOUSLY, 6.2.0 — Additive + a mandatory-order rollout: adds PermissionClaimCodec (namespace Brainograph.Utilities.Authentication), a base64url bitset over the frozen ApplicationAdminPermission ordinals, and wires JwtAuthentication's OnTokenValidated to expand that single "perms" claim back into one ApplicationAdminPermission claim per grant, in memory, before any authorization filter runs. ClaimRequirementFilter, [HasPermission], User.HasPermission and bg-content's ArticleVisibility are UNCHANGED and keep matching the claim shape they already know. Motivation: tokens carried one claim per permission, so a SuperAdmin token was 5820 chars — it overflowed the 4096-byte browser cookie the dashboard stored it in (silently) and sat close to the 8 KB per-header proxy limit; the compact form is ~30 chars for all 174. Both wire formats are accepted, so old tokens keep working. DEPLOY ORDER IS MANDATORY: every service must be on 6.2.0 BEFORE bg-identity starts minting compact tokens, or permission checks fleet-wide see an empty grant set. No existing type changed; drop-in over 6.1.0. PREVIOUSLY, 6.1.0 — Additive: adds AppRoleNames (namespace Brainograph.Utilities.Models.EntityBase), the compile-time const mirror of the frozen AppAdminRole/AppUserRole names — one const per role plus AllAdmins (11-name CSV in enum order) and All (12 names: admins + User), for use in [Authorize(Roles = ...)], which accepts constants only. Also query-ready arrays: AllAdminNames / AllAdminNormalizedNames (11, ADMIN-ONLY — the admin gate) and AllNames / AllNormalizedNames (12, includes User — NOT an admin gate); plus UserNormalized ("USER") for EF NormalizedName predicates and Service, the S2S pseudo-role held deliberately outside the frozen enums. Pinned against the enums by AppRoleNamesTests. No existing type changed; drop-in over 6.0.0. PREVIOUSLY, 6.0.0 — Unified Users: audit actor columns (CreatedBy/ModifiedBy/DeletedBy) retyped bigint→Guid on IAuditableEntity and AuditableEntity<T>; adds PlatformIdentity (pinned uuid_v5 user-map namespace + Guid.Empty service principal). Epoch *At columns, entity PKs, enums, filters and the JWT surface unchanged.
